annotations.title: Lint a Dockerfile for security and size issues

description:
Check a Dockerfile (up to 8,000 characters) for common security and image-size problems: unpinned or :latest base images, running as root, piping downloads into a shell, sensitive values baked into ENV or ARG, ADD from URLs, apt and pip cache left in layers, sudo, chmod 777 and an exposed SSH port. Returns each finding with its line, a severity and a fix, plus a score. Use before building or shipping an image. Example: dockerfile=FROM node:latest
COPY . /app
CMD node /app/server.js. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: dockerfile_lint
title: Lint a Dockerfile for security and size issues
